Market today: The mood is cautious. Rising 30-year Treasury yields and hints of another Fed rate hike are the real drivers, creating headwinds for your tech and chip names.

Your holdings: SOXL (-34.93%) and SPAL (-34.04%) are flashing red. Both are leveraged ETFs, decaying assets, and their deep drawdowns are amplified by your margin use.

Watch: Keep a close eye on bond yields and any further Fed commentary. Also, watch for any follow-through on the positive AI news for Meta, which could impact your METU.

Bottom line: Prioritize risk management on your leveraged, underperforming positions in this challenging rate environment.
plays: SOXL & SPAL: These leveraged ETFs are deep in the red. Consider trimming or exiting to reduce margin exposure and stop further decay, especially with rising rates.
No new buys today - hold and watch: The broader market signals from rising rates and bond market warnings outweigh specific positive tech news for now.
